scenes.narration: Target sells you stuff. So why is it also selling ads?
Brands pay Target for ads, through a business called Roundel. Advertising revenue rose from 649 million dollars to 915 million.
Target also shares profits from its store credit cards, 522 million dollars in 2025.
The shelves bring you in. The side businesses add up.
